## Summary

Arif Widiyanto is a security-minded DevOps Engineer, Fullstack Developer, and Security Researcher. He works across cloud infrastructure (AWS), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), CI/CD automation, fullstack application development, AI/LLM integration, and security research. His focus is practical, dependable systems: reducing cost, increasing reliability, and automating delivery pipelines. He holds 15+ years of hands-on IT experience spanning systems administration, network operations, software development, and security.
